intro: Zimbabwe has rich land and minerals but its economy collapsed in the 2000s.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Gold, platinum, lithium, tobacco and diamonds are major exports. In 2008 inflation reached billions of per cent, and Zimbabwe abandoned its own currency for years. A new currency, ZiG, was launched in 2024.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Victoria Falls and safaris draw visitors.
